verdict.rationale: Lambda's filesystems support an S3-compatible adapter enabling rclone/s5cmd to copy data out in standard formats, which gives some open-format data portability for datasets stored on Lambda filesystems. However there is no documentation of exporting other data types (account/usage records, model checkpoints beyond files, configs) in open formats, and no explicit 'no lock-in / full export' statement covering all user data. Missing for 10: comprehensive account/usage data export, explicit no-lock-in commitment, documentation of exporting non-filesystem data (e.g., cluster configs, job history) in open formats.
